title: 第25章 弄不好了一尸两命第26章 老天不给人活路
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
第25章弄不好了，一尸两命！
贵妇人环顾了一下四周，心里想着，无论小姑娘说什么，不告诉其他人就是了，也就没了冲撞一说。
“你说吧。”
“贵人，看您衣着华丽，气质非凡，想必出自名门望族，自不会缺衣少食。
吃穿用度皆是好的，胎儿——断没有营养不良之说。”
苏念禾停顿了一下，斟酌了一下用语：“若是日日进补，到了孕晚期，胎儿猛涨，头围、腹围一旦过大……到那时……”
贵妇人的手指一紧，脸上褪去了明艳，阴沉了下来：“到那时会怎样？”
“不利生产。”
苏念禾如是说。
贵妇人犹如当头棒喝，手脚冰凉：“住口！你这小姑娘休要口无遮拦！”
“我看你年纪轻轻，怎么说话这么刁钻？
你我无冤无仇，何苦要说这些话来唬我！”
自从有了身孕，婆家人可是悉心照顾，吃穿用度皆是最好的。
每餐也都是婆母精挑细选，亲自盯着烹饪的，怎么会有差池？
哪个当娘的不都是想把最好的给孩子，只有自己吃得好，胎儿才能吸收好。
她一个未出嫁的小姑娘懂什么？
罢了罢了，全当是遇到了一个无知小儿。
贵妇人提着衣摆匆匆走了，生怕多站在这一刻，沾染晦气。
苏念禾摇了摇头。
若是这个贵妇人能让她给检查下，摸摸看，评估下胎儿现在的大小，及时调整饮食结构，或许还好生些。

毕竟在古代没有剖腹产一说，生孩子就是一脚踏进鬼门关。
弄不好了，一尸两命的事儿也时常发生。
她就盼着贵妇人能早点意识到了。
而另外一种更加复杂的情况，苏念禾摇了摇脑袋，强迫自己不去想。
若她的胎儿不大，而是羊水多？
苏念禾拍打了一下自己的脸庞：“不想了，不想了，我还是遥祝这位贵人能够平安生产。”
小插曲之后，苏念禾加快脚步，掐着点儿回了侯府。
她把木桶放到东厢房后，就去膳食坊找李大厨归还背篓。
“哎呦，嘶……”
“李大叔，你怎么了？”
听到李大厨的哎哟声，苏念禾向后厨走去。
此时此刻，她正瞧着。李大厨撅着屁股，弯着腰，从灶台里往外扒拉着什么？
而地上还有一串滴血的印子。
“哎呀，是苏奶娘来了。
常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋，你大叔我跟这刀打了半辈子交道，一不留神竟轱辘手上了……”
content_en:
Chapter 25: If it goes wrong, one corpse and two lives!
The noble lady looked around and thought to herself, no matter what the little girl said, just don't tell anyone else, and there would be no need for conflict.
"You tell me."
"My lord, seeing that you are gorgeously dressed and have an extraordinary temperament, you must come from a famous family, so you will not be short of food and clothing.
The food and clothing are all good, and the fetus is definitely not malnourished. "
Su Nianhe paused and considered the words: "If you take supplements every day, in the third trimester of pregnancy, the fetus will grow rapidly, and the head circumference and abdominal circumference will become too large...by then..."
The noble lady tightened her fingers, her face lost its brightness and became gloomy: "What will happen then?"
"Not good for production."
Su Nianhe said so.
The lady was like a wake-up call, her hands and feet were cold: "Shut up! You little girl, don't stop talking!"
"I see you are so young, why do you speak so cunningly?
You and I have no grievances, so why bother saying these words to scare me! "
Since she became pregnant, her husband's family has taken good care of her and provided the best food and clothing.
My mother-in-law carefully selects every meal and cooks it herself, so how could there be any mistakes?
Every mother wants the best for her child. Only if she eats well can the fetus absorb it well.
What does she, an unmarried little girl, know?
That's all, just treat it like meeting an ignorant child.
The noble lady hurried away with her clothes in hand, fearing that standing here for too long would bring bad luck.
Su Nianhe shook his head.
If this noble lady could allow her to examine, touch and evaluate the current size of the fetus and adjust the diet in time, it might be easier to give birth.
After all, there was no such thing as caesarean section in ancient times, and giving birth was a step into hell.
If things go wrong, one person and two people will die from time to time.
She hoped that the lady would realize it soon.
As for another more complicated situation, Su Nianhe shook his head and forced himself not to think about it.
What if her fetus is not large but has excessive amniotic fluid?
Su Nianhe slapped his face: "I don't want to think about it anymore, I don't want to think about it anymore, I still wish this noble man a safe delivery."
After the interlude, Su Nianhe quickened his pace and returned to the Hou Mansion.
After she put the barrel in the east wing, she went to the restaurant to find Chef Li to return the basket.
"Ouch, hiss..."
"Uncle Li, what's wrong with you?"
Hearing Chef Li's ouch, Su Nianhe walked to the kitchen.
At this moment, she was watching. Chef Li stuck his butt out, bent over, and pulled something out from the stove?
There were still traces of blood on the ground.
"Oh, it's Nurse Su who's here.
I often walk by the river, and my shoes don’t get wet. Your uncle and I have been dealing with this knife for half my life, and I accidentally got it on my hand..."
